subject: lavaan ERROR: recoding variables for a  CFA with ordered catogorical indicators

messages.author: 377208389e94207f
messages.subject: lavaan ERROR: recoding variables for a  CFA with ordered catogorical indicators
parts:
I conducted a 2nd order CFA with ordered categorical indicators using the WLSMV estimator in lavaan, which worked out fine.

fks.model <- 'F1 =~ fks01 + fks03 + fks04 + fks05 +fks06 + fks07 + fks09
                     F2 =~ fks02 + fks08 + fks10
                     F3 =~ F1 + 1*F2
                     fks04 ~~ fks05
                     F1 ~~0*F2'
fit<- cfa(fks.model, data = good_data, std.lv=TRUE, estimator="WLSMV", ordered=c("fks01", "fks02", "fks03",  "fks04", "fks05", "fks06", "fks07", "fks08", "fks09", "fks10"))
summary(fit, standardized=T, rsquare=T, fit.measures=TRUE)

Here's the problem: Because my data is very skewed and I only have very few data points on the first three categories of my scale, I thought about recoding the items, so that my first three categories are combined into a single one; therefore my items would be scaled on 5 points rather than 7. I did the recoding using the "recode-function", making sure that the recoded items remained numerical vectors. I then copied my CFA code, without changing anything, and replaces the "old" items with the recoded ones.

fks01r <- recode(fks01, '1=1 ; 2=1 ; 3=1 ; 4=2 ; 5=3 ; 6=4 ; 7=5', as.factor.result=FALSE)

As soon as I tried to run the cfa-function, I only got a lavaan ERROR. I have no idea why, since I did not change my code, I only use recoded items in it now...

fks.model.new <- 'F1 =~ fks01r + fks03r + fks04r + fks05r +fks06r + fks07r + fks09r
             F2 =~ fks02r + fks08r + fks10r
             F3 =~ F1 + 1*F2
             fks04r ~~ fks05r
             F1 ~~0*F2'
fit1 <- cfa(fks.model.new data = good_data, std.lv=TRUE, estimator="WLSMV", ordered=c("fks01r", "fks02r", "fks03r",  "fks04r", "fks05r", "fks06r", "fks07r", "fks08r", "fks09r", "fks10r"))

Thanks for any suggestion!
Birte

messages.subject: Re: lavaan ERROR: recoding variables for a  CFA with ordered catogorical indicators
parts: Because my data is very skewed and I only have very few data points on the first three categories of my scale, I thought about recoding the items, so that my first three categories are combined into a single one; therefore my items would be scaled on 5 points rather than 7.

If you have 7 categories, the data are approximately continuous enough that ML estimates are effectively the same as the WLS estimates.  You just need to request robust SEs and test statistic to account for non-normality (e.g., estimator = "MLR", which implies se = "robust" and test = "Yuan.Bentler")

http://psych.colorado.edu/~willcutt/pdfs/Rhemtulla_2012.pdf

Shouldn't this be:

good_data$fks01r <- recode(good_data$fks01, '1=1 ; 2=1 ; 3=1 ; 4=2 ; 5=3 ; 6=4 ; 7=5',
                           as.factor.result=FALSE)

Maybe lavaan can't find fks01r because it is not in your data set.  But it's hard to speculate without seeing the full syntax that reproduces the error.
